content:
As the weather turns cooler and the peak season for autumn outdoor activities arrives, I usually adjust my everyday carry list to match my schedule. If you want a more rugged, durable product that can handle the outdoors while still working as a daily wallet, the Pelican MagSafe wallet and card case is my top pick.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers rounds up the latest products and tips in the world of MagSafe and wireless charging to help you get the most out of your wireless charging compatible Apple devices.

A top choice for outdoor activities

This Pelican wallet carries an IPX4 water resistance rating, meaning even if it gets splashed on a hike or by the lake, your credit cards and cash inside stay dry. The clasp shuts firmly and stays locked. Speaking for myself, I go to a lot of Falcons games in the fall, and even at football games I like knowing that everything is locked in and won't fall out. That alone makes it a no-brainer for autumn outdoor activities, when the weather is unpredictable. In use, it feels more like a small hard-shell protective case than just a wallet that happens to stick to the back of an iPhone.

Most MagSafe wallets are designed to hold only a few cards and nothing else. The Pelican is much more flexible. It easily fits an ID and credit cards, with room for folded bills and a small key. If you want to travel light on a hike, this wallet already covers the basics, so you don't need to carry a separate bag.

Although the Pelican wallet is built primarily for the outdoors, it works just as well as an everyday carry. Its strong magnet holds it firmly to the back of an iPhone, and the locking clasp means nothing inside will slip out. Compared with slimmer MagSafe wallets that aren't as tough, it sacrifices a little slimness in exchange for a lot more peace of mind. In the summer, when I want a more minimalist wallet, it isn't my first pick; but for hiking, ballgames, or any outing where I'll be outside for a long time and the weather might turn, it's the perfect match. For kids in their first year with an iPhone, it's also a great MagSafe wallet. My older son has been using his for a few years now.

Pelican MagSafe wallet wrap-up

The Pelican MagSafe wallet is built for people who care about durability. It protects your essentials from weather and water, easily handles a hike or a day trip, and locks securely to your device. If you're looking for a MagSafe wallet that can take a beating and still works great day to day, this is it.

You can pick up the Pelican MagSafe wallet directly from Amazon or the Pelican website.
